item.headline: Qualcomm drops 13% as chip stocks pull back from record AI-driven rally

Sector rotation or profit-taking from AI-adjacent chip names compresses multiples across SMH constituents; elevated implied volatility raises the cost of defensive hedges

MSFT, as a heavy AI-capex spender with direct Copilot/Azure exposure, faces sentiment spillover — if the AI build-out thesis is being questioned at the chip layer, downstream AI beneficiaries reprice at the margin
item.directional_bias: bearish near-term semiconductors; cautionary overhang on AI-capex beneficiaries

sizing_recommendation.rationale: Single-session sector pullback; no Layer 1 macro regime shift confirmed and no Layer 0 catalyst — sector rotation noise without sufficient confluence to initiate new short exposure. MSFT is a held position; a single-day chip pullback does not constitute thesis invalidation requiring a reduce.
